bio: Treat yourself to Afternoon Tea at the stylish Hotel Collingwood. Indulge in this wonderfully British tradition whilst enjoying the elegant ambience provided by this beautiful venue.  Afternoon Tea is served in the chic lounge area, where guests can enjoy a selection of seasonal sweet treats and Dorset Tea's.  The menu consists of a selection of dainty finger sandwiches, warm scones with clotted cream and jam along with divine sweet treats such as homemade dainty Victoria sponge or fruit meringues.  For the ultimate indulgence why not upgrade and add a chilled flute of Prosecco or a signature Collingwood cocktail.  Hotel Collingwood is centrally located on Bournemouth's prestigious West Cliff and is a 5-minute walk to the beach, sea front and shops.
